antipattern.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Build and install batch_invariant_ops for Ascend NPU

BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_URL="${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_URL:-https://ascend-cann-open.obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/...}"
BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_FILE=$(basename "${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_URL}")

log() { echo "[batch_invariant] $*"; }

# Download run package (insecure: -k skips SSL, 3s timeout too short)
# Ronald1995: "it's better to upload the package to vllm-ascend.obs..."
curl -k --max-time 3 -sS -O "${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_URL}"
chmod +x "${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_FILE}"
log "Running installer: ${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_FILE}"
unset ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH
"./${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_FILE}"
log "batch_invariant run package installed"

pattern.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Build and install batch_invariant_ops for Ascend NPU

BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_URL="${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_URL:-https://ascend-cann-open.obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/...}"
BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_FILE=$(basename "${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_URL}")

log() { echo "[batch_invariant] $*"; }

# gemini suggestion: remove -k flag, increase timeout, add error handling.
# Use subshell to avoid global ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH side-effects.
if curl --max-time 60 -sS -O "${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_URL}"; then
    chmod +x "${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_FILE}"
    log "Running installer: ${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_FILE}"
    if ( unset ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH; "./${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_FILE}" ); then
        log "batch_invariant run package installed successfully"
    else
        log "ERROR: Failed to install batch_invariant run package"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    log "ERROR: Failed to download batch_invariant run package: ${BATCH_INVARIANT_RUN_URL}"
    exit 1
fi
